ns2:course.label: Human Anatomy & Physiology I
ns2:course.description: Organ system biology with an emphasis on normal human anatomy and physiology, physiological processes and associated disease processes of the following systems; skeletal, muscle, nervous, sensory, and endocrine. Credit is not given for both MCB 244 and any of MCB 103, MCB 240, MCB 315, MCB 334. Prerequisite: Credit or concurrent enrollment in CHEM 101, CHEM 102, or equivalent; or consent of instructor.
